title: Concrete Calculator
metaDescription: Estimate cubic yards and 40, 50, 60, 80, or 90 lb concrete bags for a slab, footing, or Sonotube, using Quikrete and Sakrete data-sheet bag yields.
secondaryKeywords: how many bags of concrete make a yard
how many 80 lb bags of concrete in a yard
intent: Estimate cubic yards and the number of 40/50/60/80/90 lb premix bags needed for a slab, footing, or round column.
registerRow: Keyword Register: concrete calculator (Volume 5, Competition ease 2, Ad value 3, Fit 5, Priority 30)
intro: Enter your slab, footing, or round column size to get the cubic yards of concrete and the number of premix bags to buy. Bag counts use the yield printed on each manufacturer's data sheet, not a generic rule of thumb.
chartTitle: Bags needed at other thicknesses (slab) or diameters (column), same bag size
uniqueAddition: Brand-yield comparison table (Quikrete 1101 vs Sakrete High-Strength vs Quikrete Fast-Setting, bags per cubic yard for every size, linked to each data sheet) plus a sizes table for common slab dimensions; the chart shows bag counts at other thicknesses or diameters.

inputs.name: shape
inputs.label: What are you pouring?
inputs.help: Setting fence posts? Use the Fence Calculator instead.

inputs.name: quantity
inputs.label: How many identical pours
inputs.help: Whole number, 1 to 50. For example, 4 for four matching deck-footing columns.

inputs.name: length
inputs.label: Length
inputs.help: 0.1 to 200 ft. Use decimals for inches (10 ft 6 in = 10.5).

inputs.name: thickness
inputs.label: Thickness
inputs.help: 1 to 24 in. 4 in is a common patio or walkway thickness; Sakrete's data sheet calls for at least 4 in on flatwork.

inputs.name: diameter
inputs.label: Diameter
inputs.help: 4 to 48 in. Use the inside diameter of the form tube.

inputs.name: height
inputs.label: Height
inputs.help: 6 to 120 in. The depth of concrete in the tube or hole.

inputs.name: brand
inputs.label: Concrete mix
inputs.help: Each brand prints its own yield per bag on its data sheet (linked under Sources).

inputs.name: bagSize
inputs.label: Bag size
inputs.help: Sizes a mix isn't sold in are greyed out. 90 lb Quikrete is regional.

inputs.name: waste
inputs.label: Waste allowance
inputs.help: 0 to 25%. Extra for spills, uneven ground, and form bulge. 5% is our starting estimate, not a manufacturer figure.

sources.title: QUIKRETE Concrete Mix, Product No. 1101 data sheet (The Quikrete Companies): yields for 40, 50, 60, 80, and 90 lb bags
Sakrete High-Strength Concrete Mix technical data sheet (Sakrete of North America): yields for 40, 60, 80, and 90 lb bags
QUIKRETE Fast-Setting Concrete Mix, Product No. 1004 data sheet (The Quikrete Companies): yields for 50 and 60 lb bags
